title: Late Night Vibes: A Mix of R&B, Hip Hop, and Indie
htmlContent:
This playlist is a fusion of different genres that all create a smooth, relaxing atmosphere. "Lavish" by Justin Garner sets the tone with its soulful vocals and R&B sound. "Over Time" by Zims brings a chill hip-hop vibe to the playlist, while "Just When" by Odysshey adds a smooth, 2000s R&B feel. "Dear Diary" by P Rhymes is a thought-provoking track that blends a personal narrative with social commentary, and "Lie to Me If You Have To" by Carlo Monte wraps up the playlist with its dreamy indie sound.

This playlist is perfect for winding down after a long day or setting the mood for a chill night. It features a mix of R&B, Hip Hop, and Indie tracks that will make you want to sway along and get lost in the music.

  • "Lavish" by Justin Garner

Justin Garner's latest single 'Lavish' is a powerful showcase of his exceptional talent as a singer, songwriter, and performer. With soaring vocals, stellar songwriting, and incredible production, the track highlights his versatility and creativity in bringing R&B to the forefront. With an upcoming album 'A Man and His Vices' on the horizon, Justin Garner is poised to continue his ascent in the music industry. Hailing from Plaquemine, Louisiana, he has already cemented his place in the industry through his original music and work with top artists.

Stay connected to Justin Garner below:

 TikTok | Facebook | Spotify | YouTube | Instagram 

  • "Over Time" by Zims

Zim, the London-born rapper from Croydon, recently dropped his latest hip-hop track, "Over Time." With a catchy beat and introspective lyrics, the song touches on themes of hard work, perseverance, and personal growth. Zim's smooth flow and authentic storytelling make "Over Time" a must-listen for fans of the genre.

Stay connected to Zims below:

TikTok | Spotify | Instagram

  • "Just When" by Odysshey

Odysshey's recent release, "Just When," is a soulful R&B track with a nostalgic feel that transports listeners back to the 2000s. The song encourages self-love and motivation to pursue personal goals. As a talented R&B/Soul artist from the UK, Odysshey's sultry voice will captivate fans and leave them wanting more.

Stay connected to Odysshey below:

Facebook | Spotify | Instagram 

  • "Dear Diary" by P Rhymes

P Rhymes - Dear Diary About the song: A creative take on how world events make us think and feel within our own mindscapes while at the same time reflecting on personal goals and ridiculing what is happening around us. This is how people may record their accounts when keeping a diary. About the artist: West London Lyricist who grew up in the 90s/2000 HipHop. Passionate about delivering my own style and creativity with out-of-the-box ideas and expression behind a refined and constant flow.

Stay connected to P Rhymes below:

TikTok | Spotify | Instagram

  • "Lie to Me If You Have To" by Carlo Monte

Carlo Monte, an indie artist from the USA, releases "Lie to Me If You Have To," a poignant track that explores the struggles of communication and vulnerability in relationships. With emotive vocals and a stripped-down arrangement, Monte delivers a raw and honest portrayal of the complexities of love and trust.

Stay connected to Carlo Monte below:

Spotify

Late Night Vibes is a playlist that captures the essence of relaxation and introspection. Each track tells a story and brings a unique energy to the playlist, making it the perfect background music for any chill night. So sit back, relax, and let the music take you away.
